observations.behavior: Replaces cached, unparameterized pool manager with a bounded, parameterized cache keyed by (verify, server_hostname).
observations.posthog_connection: ClickHouse warehouse ingestion: shared urllib3 pool manager cache bounded to prevent unbounded memory growth; server_hostname supplied for SNI and certificate validation, not just loopback. This supports secure, proxied, and tunnel-loopback connections while retaining the egress proxy for customer-supplied hosts.

observations.behavior: Adds server_hostname parameter to client and metadata functions; checks bypass_env_proxy == "tunnel_loopback" against host.
observations.posthog_connection: ClickHouse warehouse ingestion: enforces that tunnel-loopback bypass only applies to loopback addresses, preserving the egress proxy for customer-supplied hosts. This maintains SSRF protection while allowing internal-team or tunnel-loopback bypasses.
